rcaNotes: None required for the hub itself: NotesActivity.open(ctx, tab, bookId) is the frozen entry point. Entry points owned by others: reader overflow '독서 노트' → NotesActivity.open(this, NotesTab.ALL, currentBookId) on main (READER/RC-A, ReaderMenus).

ReaderActivity must accept ReaderActivity.open(context, bookId, ReaderJump) from the hub (jump to a note) and refresh highlights on resume via reloadAnnotations (existing 1 s guard), since the hub deletes/recolours quotes.
